summary: Yield response-expiry maintenance after 20ms of cooperative work as well as 64 receipts

replay.detail: No replay; unexamined receipts remain queued for the next maintenance transaction.

rules.detail: Durable clock validation, live response pinning and operation identity protection are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Receipt cleanup may commit fewer than 64 candidates; cleanup counts describe only the committed prefix.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon restart deploys the cooperative maintenance limit.

recovery.detail: Failed transactions roll back their prefix; later maintenance resumes from durable receipt order. One response check, mutation or COMMIT can exceed the cooperative budget.
